preparation: Aladdin sodium butyrate mixed into basal rabbit feed at 0.75 g/kg diet
identity_boundary: BODYBIO sodium butyrate 300 mg capsules in the separate human COPD report

source.title: Dietary supplement of sodium butyrate improves the growth performance and intestinal health by targeting Wnt/beta-catenin signaling pathway in rabbits
source.raw_data_repository: None; the article says datasets are available from corresponding authors on reasonable request.
source.supplementary_file: Wiley linked aro271-sup-0001-suppl-data.docx; download returned HTTP 403 and was not bypassed.

growth: higher body weight in treatment group during weeks 6-10
higher average daily gain during weeks 2-7
feed conversion ratio and diarrhea score improved as reported

transcriptomic_context.BUB1B_observation: BUB1B is listed in a cell-cycle gene cluster whose expression is reported as positively correlated with muscle-fiber density; the article does not give a BUB1B-specific treatment effect or validate BUB1B by qPCR/protein in the accessible main text.

material_limits: Muscle strength, fatigue, endurance and absolute contractile force were not measured.
No BUBR1 protein, checkpoint function, chromosome-fidelity or MVA assay was reported.
Cecal BUB1B association is not a skeletal-muscle BUB1B effect or causal mediation.
BUB1B-specific fold change and gene-level P/q value were not recovered; supplement and raw RNA-seq data were unavailable.
Small, single-species cohort; no human or pediatric exposure bridge.

Serum GGT, bile acids, cholesterol, triglycerides, creatinine, urea and glucose increased, total CO2 decreased, and heart/liver/lung weights decreased; significance does not establish clinical harm or safety.

human_context.preparation: BODYBIO 300 mg sodium butyrate capsule, 12 weeks, older men with COPD

competitive_assessment.disposition: Common-compound muscle/gut reserve; not a BUB1B restoration lead.
competitive_assessment.relative_to_nmn: Less direct: no measured BubR1 abundance response.
competitive_assessment.relative_to_niacin: No human muscle NAD engagement or direct BUBR1 assay.
competitive_assessment.relative_to_apitegromab: The human butyrate COPD report lacks a recovered between-arm functional contrast; rabbit muscle morphology and growth are not clinical muscle-function evidence.
recommended_next_measurements: BUB1B RNA and BUBR1 protein in the same treated samples
progenitor renewal and absolute muscle contractile output

reading_scope: Targeted reading of the official Wiley article's treatment/transcriptome methods, relevant growth/muscle and BUB1B-correlation results, captions, limitations and data-availability statement; not exhaustive article review. Supplementary DOCX download returned HTTP 403 and was not bypassed. No raw sequence data or BUB1B-specific expression value was independently reanalyzed.

sources.scope: Distinct BODYBIO human COPD study, separately qualified in gut-muscle-qualification.md
